newsitem.title: ITALY: Deutsche's Italy fund unit in bd. reshuffle.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche's Italy fund unit in bd. reshuffle.

text.p: Finanza & Futuro Spa, the Italian fund management arm of the Deutsche Bank group, said former cabinet minister Luigi Spaventa was standing down as chairman and would be replaced by a German.
F&F said in a statement Christian Strenger, Managing Director of DWS which owns 70 percent of the Italian fund manager, would take over from Spaventa.

The statement also said F&F's Managing Director, Antonio Corti, was leaving the group and his place would taken by Renato Rota, currently director of the Milan office of Deutsche Bank Spa. Milan newsroom +392-66102321
